newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Scientology member defuses bomb near church.
newsitem.headline: French Scientology member defuses bomb near church.

text.p: A member of the U.S.-based Church of Scientology defused on Friday a bomb found in one of its churches in Angers in western France and primed to explode within minutes, police sources said.
The sources said the device, concealed in a sports bag, was found on Friday morning at the church near Angers railway station. The person who found it immediately carried it to a nearby park.
"The explosive device was made to kill and was very powerful," one investigator said. Several eyewitnesses said the bomb had been primed to explode a few minutes later.
